a.xlink:title: student_verifications One effective approved verification per user requires a partial unique index on user_id WHERE status = approved (BR-070).
skills Only the skill itself is modeled; category hierarchy and tags await OQ-001.
skill_evidence Publication requires current approved evidence for the Teacher and skill (BR-008, BR-015).
evidence_decisions A Verifier decision needs an active assignment for the evidence skill and reviewer_id <> teacher_id (BR-011..BR-013). Administrator decisions are recorded without assignment.

bookings Check at write time: Learner differs from Teacher (BR-068), starts_at >= now + 24h (BR-021), capacity available (BR-025); booking and settlement commit atomically (BR-026). A partial unique index should prevent multiple valid bookings per learner/class (BR-024).
wallets Balance is derived from posted ledger entries. One system wallet per kind is an operational invariant.

ledger_transactions Each posted transaction has at least two entries whose signed amounts sum to zero. Booking settlements need a partial unique index on booking_id WHERE kind = booking; later release/reversal may reference the same booking.
ledger_entries Example 100-credit booking: Learner available -100, Teacher pending +90, platform fee +10. Commission rounding is OQ-012.
withdrawal_requests Withdrawal limits, fees, release timing and gateway selection await OQ-005, OQ-006, OQ-011.
gateway_events Exactly one of top_up_id or withdrawal_id. Verify signature and reject stale/replayed transitions before posting.
messages Read/write access requires Teacher or a valid booking participant. Contact handling awaits OQ-009.
ratings Learner identity comes from Booking; only a completed, eligible booking may be rated once.
